title: Adi-khanda, part 6 (portion 14)
html:
The beginning of the Pauganda-lila: Vishvambhara begins to learn His letters; the chudakarana rite; a game on the sandy bank of the Ganga following the tracks of birds; Jagannatha Mishra's anger and Shachi's intercession; Jagannatha's dream: a brahmana reveals to him that his son is the Lord Himself

Pauganda-lila (The Boyhood Pastimes)

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. When Gaurasundara, having heard Murari expound the scripture of yoga, began to mock him by imitating his gestures and manners, Murari in anger spoke harsh words to Him. In return, Sriman Mahaprabhu, to show the worthlessness of yoga and what becomes of the yogi, urinated into Murari's plate during his midday meal and instructed him in the supremacy of devotion to Krishna. Then the author, having described how Sriman Mahaprabhu enacted the pastime of sankirtana with the boys of His age, the sannyasa of Vishvarupa as told in a conversation between Murari and Damodara, the grief of Shachi and Jagannatha and so on, proceeds to describe Gaurasundara's Pauganda-lila. In due time the chudakarana and other rites of Gaurahari were duly performed. As prescribed, at an auspicious moment chalk was placed in His hand;1 He […]2 Mishra Purandara, learning [in a dream] that [his son] is Bhagavan, was enlightened; but when this mood of his […], he became absorbed once more in his parental love (vatsalya). At the appointed time Gaurahari's upanayana rite was performed according to rule. Then the teaching on the avataras of the four yugas is set out. At the end of the Dvapara-yuga, Bhagavan Himself, Sri Krishna, the son of the king of Vraja, appears. In the Kali-yuga, assuming the feelings and the lustre of Srimati Radha, He descends in a hidden way in the form of Sri Gaurasundara to preach the dharma of the age — the sankirtana of Hari's name. Intoxicated with prema, He gave prema away, offering it at the door of every living being. During His life as a householder, by forbidding His mother to eat grains on the day of Ekadashi, He taught the living beings of the world. When Jagannatha Mishra fell ill, He instructed about the impermanence of human life and comforted His mother in many ways. When Jagannatha Mishra passed from this world, Shachi-devi mourned her husband; Gaurahari too mourned His father. After that He began His studies […].3

Raga dhanashi

এইমতে আর দিনে মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
চিন্তিতে লাগিলা মনে দেখি বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ৪৫৭ ॥

eimate āra dine miśra purandara |
cintite lāgilā mane dekhi biśbambhara || 457 ||

eimate — thus; ara dine — on another day; mishra purandara — Mishra Purandara; chintite lagila mane — began to reflect in his mind; dekhi vishvambhara — looking at Vishvambhara

457Thus one day Mishra Purandara,
looking at Vishvambhara, began to reflect.

শুভদিন শুভক্ষণ তিথি সুনক্ষত্র ।
হাথে খড়ি দিল তার সময় বিচিত্র ॥ ৪৫৮ ॥

śubhadina śubhakṣaṇa tithi sunakṣatra |
hāthe khaṛi dila tāra samaẏa bicitra || 458 ||

shubhadina shubhakshana — auspicious day, auspicious moment; tithi sunakshatra — [good] tithi and nakshatra; hathe khadi dila tara — placed chalk in His hand; samaya vichitra — a wonderful occasion

458On an auspicious day, at an auspicious moment, under a good tithi and nakshatra,
he placed chalk in His hand1 — a wonderful occasion it was.

দিনে দিনে পড়ে সেই জগতের গুরু ।
দেখি শচী-জগন্নাথ আপনা পাশরু ॥ ৪৫৯ ॥

dine dine paṛe sei jagatera guru |
dekhi śacī-jagannātha āpanā pāśaru || 459 ||

dine dine pade — day by day studies; sei jagatera guru — He, the Guru of the world; dekhi — seeing; shachi-jagannatha apana pasaru — Shachi and Jagannatha forget themselves

459Day by day He studies, the Guru of the world;
seeing this, Shachi and Jagannatha forget themselves.

কি মধুর করি প্রভু ক খ গ ঘ বোলে ।
দেখি শচী জগন্নাথ সব দুখ ভোলে ॥ ৪৫৯+১ ॥

ki madhura kari prabhu ka kha ga gha bole |
dekhi śacī jagannātha saba dukha bhole || 459+1 ||

ki madhura kari — how sweetly; prabhu — the Lord; ka kha ga gha bole — says "ka, kha, ga, gha"; dekhi — seeing [this]; shachi jagannatha — Shachi and Jagannatha; saba dukha bhole — forget all sorrow

459+1How sweetly the Lord says "ka, kha, ga, gha"!4
Seeing this, Shachi and Jagannatha forget every sorrow.

দিন দুই তিনে সে লিখিল সব ফলা ।
নিরন্তর লিখেন কৃষ্ণের নামমালা ॥ ৪৫৯+২ ॥

dina dui tine se likhila saba phalā |
nirantara likhena kṛṣṇera nāmamālā || 459+2 ||

dina dui tine — in two or three days; se — He; likhila — wrote (learned to write); saba phala — all the phala signs (all the letters with their signs); nirantara — unceasingly; likhena — writes; krishnera namamala — the garland of Krishna's names

459+2In two or three days He learned to write all the letters with all their signs;
unceasingly He writes out garlands of Krishna's names:

রামকৃষ্ণ গোবিন্দ গোপাল বনমালী ।
অহর্নিশ লিখেন পড়েন কুতূহলী ॥ ৪৫৯+৩ ॥

rāmakṛṣṇa gobinda gopāla banamālī |
aharniśa likhena paṛena kutūhalī || 459+3 ||

rama krishna govinda gopala vanamali — "Rama, Krishna, Govinda, Gopala, Vanamali"; aharnisha — day and night; likhena padena — writes and reads; kutuhali — with delight

459+3"Rama, Krishna, Govinda, Gopala, Vanamali" —
day and night He writes and reads them with delight.

এইমতে খেলা-লীলায় কথোদিন গেল ।
জগন্নাথ শচী দোঁহে যুকতি করিল ॥ ৪৬০ ॥

eimate khelā-līlāẏa kathodina gela |
jagannātha śacī doṁhe yukati karila || 460 ||

eimate — thus; khela-lilaya — in play; kathodina gela — some days passed; jagannatha shachi donhe — Jagannatha and Shachi both; yukati karila — took counsel

460Thus some days passed in play,
and Jagannatha and Shachi both took counsel together.

বিশ্বম্ভর-চূড়াকর্ম করি মনে মনে ।
ইষ্ট-কুটুম্ব যত আনিল তখনে ॥ ৪৬১ ॥

biśbambhara-cūṛākarma kari mane mane |
iṣṭa-kuṭumba yata ānila takhane || 461 ||

vishvambhara-chudakarma — Vishvambhara's chudakarana; kari mane mane — resolving in their minds; ishta-kutumba yata — all friends and kinsfolk; anila takhane — invited then

461Having resolved in their minds on Vishvambhara's chudakarana,5
they then invited all their friends and kinsfolk.

চর্চিল সে শুভক্ষণ তিথি শুভদিনে ।
করিব ত চূড়াকর্ম দঢ়াইল মনে ॥ ৪৬২ ॥

carcila se śubhakṣaṇa tithi śubhadine |
kariba ta cūṛākarma daṛhāila mane || 462 ||

charchila se — they considered; shubhakshana tithi shubhadine — the auspicious moment, tithi and auspicious day; kariba ta chudakarma — "we shall perform the chudakarana"; dadhaila mane — made firm in their minds

462Having considered the auspicious moment, tithi and day,
they made their decision firm: "We shall perform the chudakarana."

নদীয়ানগরে ঘরে ঘরে আনন্দিত ।
ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন আনি লোকে যে পূজিত ॥ ৪৬৩ ॥

nadīẏānagare ghare ghare ānandita |
brāhmaṇa-sajjana āni loke ye pūjita || 463 ||

nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; ghare ghare anandita — every house rejoiced; brahmana-sajjana ani — inviting brahmanas and worthy men; loke ye pujita — honoured by people

463In the town of Nadia every house rejoiced;
they invited brahmanas and worthy men honoured by all.

ব্রাহ্মণেতে বেদ পড়ে গায়নে গায় গীত ।
করিল সে যজ্ঞবিধি যে ছিল উচিত ॥ ৪৬৪ ॥

brāhmaṇete beda paṛe gāẏane gāẏa gīta |
karila se yajñabidhi ye chila ucita || 464 ||

brahmanete veda pade — the brahmanas recite the Vedas; gayane gaya gita — singers sing songs; karila se yajna-vidhi — performed the sacrificial rite; ye chhila uchita — as was proper

464The brahmanas recite the Vedas, the singers sing songs;
the sacrificial rite was performed as was proper.

জয় জয় দেই যত কুলবধূজন ।
সভাকারে দিল গন্ধ গুবাক চন্দন ॥ ৪৬৫ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa dei yata kulabadhūjana |
sabhākāre dila gandha gubāka candana || 465 ||

jaya jaya dei — raise "jaya, jaya"; yata kulavadhujana — all the respectable women; sabhakare dila — gave to everyone; gandha guvaka chandana — perfume, betel nut, sandal

465All the respectable women raise the cry "Jaya, jaya!";
to everyone were given perfumes, betel nut and sandal.

নানা বাদ্যভাণ্ড বাজে আনন্দ অপার ।
শঙ্খ দুন্দুভি বাজে ভেউর কাহাল ॥ ৪৬৬ ॥

nānā bādyabhāṇḍa bāje ānanda apāra |
śaṅkha dundubhi bāje bheura kāhāla || 466 ||

nana vadyabhanda baje — all kinds of instruments sound; ananda apara — boundless joy; shankha dundubhi baje — conches and dundubhis sound; bheura kahala — bheur and kahal horns

466All kinds of instruments sound — the joy is boundless:
conches, dundubhis, bheur and kahal horns resound;

মৃদঙ্গ পটহ বাজে কাংস্য করতাল ।
সানাই-শবদ শুনি বড়ই রসাল ॥ ৪৬৭ ॥

mṛdaṅga paṭaha bāje kāṃsya karatāla |
sānāi-śabada śuni baṛai rasāla || 467 ||

mridanga pataha baje — mridangas and pataha drums sound; kamsya karatala — bronze cymbals; sanai-shabada shuni — hearing the sound of the sanai; badai rasala — most sweet

467mridangas, pataha drums and bronze cymbals resound;
the sound of the sanai is sweetness itself to hear.

চতুর্দিকে হরিধ্বনি ঝাঁপয়ে গগন ।
চূড়াকর্ম কর্ণবেধ করিল তখন ॥ ৪৬৮ ॥

caturdike haridhbani jhāṁpaẏe gagana |
cūṛākarma karṇabedha karila takhana || 468 ||

chaturdike haridhvani — on all sides cries of "Hari"; jhanpaye gagana — cover the sky; chudakarma karnavedha — the chudakarana and ear-piercing; karila takhana — were performed then

468On all sides cries of "Hari!" fill the sky;
then the chudakarana and the ear-piercing were performed.

আনন্দিত হৈল সব নদীয়ানগরী ।
বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখ দেখি আপনা পাশরি ॥ ৪৬৯ ॥

ānandita haila saba nadīẏānagarī |
biśbambhara-mukha dekhi āpanā pāśari || 469 ||

anandita haila — rejoiced; saba nadiya-nagari — the whole town of Nadia; vishvambhara-mukha dekhi — seeing Vishvambhara's face; apana pasari — forgetting themselves

469The whole town of Nadia rejoiced:
seeing Vishvambhara's face, people forget themselves.

হাটে বাটে ঘাটে যেই যথা তথা যায় ।
দোঁহে দোঁহা মেলি গোরাচাঁদের গুণ গায় ॥ ৪৭০ ॥

hāṭe bāṭe ghāṭe yei yathā tathā yāẏa |
doṁhe doṁhā meli gorācāṁdera guṇa gāẏa || 470 ||

hate bate ghate — in the market, on the road, at the ghat; yei yatha tatha yaya — whoever goes anywhere; donhe donha meli — two meeting each other; gorachandera guna gaya — sing Gorachand's glories

470In the market, on the road, at the ghat — wherever anyone goes,
when two meet, they sing of Gorachand's glories.

পর-পুত্র দেখি হেন করয়ে হৃদয় ।
শচী-জগন্নাথ-ভাগ্য এ হেন তনয় ॥ ৪৭১ ॥

para-putra dekhi hena karaẏe hṛdaẏa |
śacī-jagannātha-bhāgya e hena tanaẏa || 471 ||

para-putra dekhi — seeing another's son; hena karaye hridaya — thus they feel in their hearts; shachi-jagannatha-bhagya — the fortune of Shachi and Jagannatha; e hena tanaya — such a son

471Seeing another's son, this is what they feel in their hearts:
"It is Shachi and Jagannatha's good fortune — such a son!

নবদ্বীপের ভাগ্য আর সংসারের ভাগ্য ।
ও রূপ দেখিলে হয় নয়ানের শ্লাঘ্য ॥ ৪৭২ ॥

nabadbīpera bhāgya āra saṃsārera bhāgya |
o rūpa dekhile haẏa naẏānera ślāghya || 472 ||

navadvipera bhagya — the fortune of Navadvipa; ara samsarera bhagya — and the fortune of the world; o rupa dekhile — on seeing that form; haya nayanera shlaghya — the eyes become praiseworthy

472It is the good fortune of Navadvipa and the good fortune of the world;
whoever sees that form — his eyes are worthy of praise."

এ বোল শুনিয়া সর্বজনের উল্লাস ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪৭২+১ ॥

e bola śuniẏā sarbajanera ullāsa |
ānanda-hṛdaẏe kahe e locanadāsa || 472+1 ||

e bola suniya — hearing these words; sarvajanera ullasa — the rejoicing of all people; ananda-hridaye — with bliss in the heart; kahe e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa tells

472+1Hearing such words, everyone rejoices;
with bliss in his heart Lochana Dasa tells this.6

আর একদিনে গঙ্গা-বালুকার তটে ।
বালক সহিতে ক্রীড়া করে গঙ্গাঘাটে ॥ ৪৭৩ ॥

āra ekadine gaṅgā-bālukāra taṭe |
bālaka sahite krīṛā kare gaṅgāghāṭe || 473 ||

ara ekadine — on another day; ganga-valukara tate — on the sandy bank of the Ganga; balaka sahite krida kare — plays with the boys; gangaghate — at the Ganga ghat

473On another day, on the sandy bank of the Ganga,
He is playing with the boys at the ghat.

বালুকায় পক্ষিগণ-পদ অনুসারি ।
গমন করিলা পক্ষি-পদচিহ্ন ধরি ॥ ৪৭৪ ॥

bālukāẏa pakṣigaṇa-pada anusāri |
gamana karilā pakṣi-padacihna dhari || 474 ||

valukaya — on the sand; pakshigana-pada anusari — following the tracks of birds; gamana karila — walked; pakshi-padachihna dhari — keeping to the birds' footprints

474Following the tracks of birds on the sand,
He walked, stepping exactly in the birds' footprints.

ইহা বলি মহাপ্রভু শ্রীগৌরচন্দ্র ।
বালক-সহিতে ক্রীড়া করিল নির্বন্ধ ॥ ৪৭৫ ॥

ihā bali mahāprabhu śrīgauracandra |
bālaka-sahite krīṛā karila nirbandha || 475 ||

iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu shri-gaurachandra — Mahaprabhu Sri Gaurachandra; balaka-sahite — with the boys; krida karila nirbandha — set a rule for the game

475Saying this,7 Mahaprabhu Sri Gaurachandra
set a rule for the game with the boys:

এই পদচিহ্ন যেই বালক ডিঙ্গায় ।
সেই ততক্ষণে খেলা পরাজয় পায় ॥ ৪৭৬ ॥

ei padacihna yei bālaka ḍiṅgāẏa |
sei tatakṣaṇe khelā parājaẏa pāẏa || 476 ||

ei padachihna — these footprints; yei balaka dingaya — whichever boy steps over; sei tatakshane — he at once; khela parajaya paya — loses the game

476"Whichever boy steps beyond these footprints
loses the game at once.

যে জনা ত আগে ধাঞা পারে ধরিবার ।
সেই জন খেলা জিনে কান্ধে চড়ে তার ॥ ৪৭৭ ॥

ye janā ta āge dhāñā pāre dharibāra |
sei jana khelā jine kāndhe caṛe tāra || 477 ||

ye jana ta age dhana — whoever, running ahead; pare dharibara — can catch; sei jana khela jine — he wins the game; kandhe chade tara — rides on the other's shoulders

477Whoever can run ahead and catch [another]
wins the game and rides on his shoulders.

তার কান্ধে চড়ি তার পিঠে মারে ছাট ।
কান্ধে করি লঞা যায় সঙ্কেতের ঘাট ॥ ৪৭৮ ॥

tāra kāndhe caṛi tāra piṭhe māre chāṭa |
kāndhe kari lañā yāẏa saṅketera ghāṭa || 478 ||

tara kandhe chadi — riding on his shoulders; tara pithe mare chhata — whips his back with a switch; kandhe kari lana yaya — [the other] carries him on his shoulders; sanketera ghata — to the agreed ghat

478Riding on his shoulders, he whips his back with a switch,
and the other carries him on his shoulders to the agreed ghat."

ইহা বলি শিশুসনে বালুকায় ধায় ।
মহাপরিশ্রমে ঘর্ম নিকলিছে গায় ॥ ৪৭৯ ॥

ihā bali śiśusane bālukāẏa dhāẏa |
mahāpariśrame gharma nikaliche gāẏa || 479 ||

iha bali — saying this; shishusane — with the children; valukaya dhaya — runs over the sand; mahaparishrame — from great exertion; gharma nikalichhe gaya — sweat streams from His body

479Saying this, He runs over the sand with the children;
from great exertion sweat streams down His body.

হেনকালে জগন্নাথ মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
স্নান করিবারে গেলা জাহ্নবীর তীর ॥ ৪৮০ ॥

henakāle jagannātha miśra purandara |
snāna karibāre gelā jāhnabīra tīra || 480 ||

henakale — at that time; jagannatha mishra purandara — Jagannatha Mishra Purandara; snana karibare — to bathe; gela jahnavira tira — went to the bank of the Jahnavi

480At that time Jagannatha Mishra Purandara
went to the bank of the Jahnavi to bathe.

দেখিয়া পুত্রের খেলা ক্রোধ উপজিল ।
পরিশ্রম দেখি হিয়া পুড়িতে লাগিল ॥ ৪৮১ ॥

dekhiẏā putrera khelā krodha upajila |
pariśrama dekhi hiẏā puṛite lāgila || 481 ||

dekhiya putrera khela — seeing his son's game; krodha upajila — anger arose; parishrama dekhi — seeing the exhaustion; hiya pudite lagila — his heart began to burn

481Seeing his son's game, he grew angry;
seeing Him so worn out, the father's heart began to burn:

সুবর্ণ-পদ্ম যেন আতপেতে ম্লান ।
মধু নিকলয়ে যেন বদনের ঘাম ॥ ৪৮২ ॥

subarṇa-padma yena ātapete mlāna |
madhu nikalaẏe yena badanera ghāma || 482 ||

suvarna-padma yena — as if a golden lotus; atapete mlana — wilted in the heat; madhu nikalaye yena — as if honey oozes; vadanera ghama — the sweat on the face

482it was as if a golden lotus had wilted in the heat,
and the sweat on His face was like honey oozing out.

ডাকিতে ডাকিতে মিশ্র যায় পাছে পাছে ।
পিতা দেখি বিশ্বম্ভর পাইল বড় লাজে ॥ ৪৮৩ ॥

ḍākite ḍākite miśra yāẏa pāche pāche |
pitā dekhi biśbambhara pāila baṛa lāje || 483 ||

dakite dakite — calling and calling; mishra yaya pachhe pachhe — Mishra follows behind; pita dekhi — seeing His father; vishvambhara paila bada laje — Vishvambhara was greatly abashed

483Calling out again and again, Mishra follows Him;
seeing His father, Vishvambhara was greatly abashed.

লাজে মুখ নাহি তুলে অন্তরে তরাস ।
আপনি পণ্ডিত গেলা গোরাচাঁদের পাশ ॥ ৪৮৪ ॥

lāje mukha nāhi tule antare tarāsa |
āpani paṇḍita gelā gorācāṁdera pāśa || 484 ||

laje mukha nahi tule — out of shame does not raise His face; antare tarasa — fear within; apani pandita — the pandit himself; gela gorachandera pasha — went to Gorachand

484Out of shame He does not raise His face, fear in His heart;
the pandit himself went up to Gorachand,

করে ধরি লঞা আইলা আপন কুমার ।
সকল বালক গেলা ঘর আপনার ॥ ৪৮৫ ॥

kare dhari lañā āilā āpana kumāra |
sakala bālaka gelā ghara āpanāra || 485 ||

kare dhari — taking by the hand; lana aila apana kumara — brought his son away; sakala balaka — all the boys; gela ghara apanara — went to their homes

485took Him by the hand and led his son away;
all the boys went off to their homes.

জগন্নাথ গঙ্গাস্নান করি আইলা ঘর ।
ঘরে আসি গোরাচাঁদে গঞ্জিলা বিস্তর ॥ ৪৮৬ ॥

jagannātha gaṅgāsnāna kari āilā ghara |
ghare āsi gorācāṁde gañjilā bistara || 486 ||

jagannatha gangasnana kari — Jagannatha, having bathed in the Ganga; aila ghara — came home; ghare asi — coming home; gorachande ganjila vistara — scolded Gorachand at length

486Having bathed in the Ganga, Jagannatha came home
and, on coming home, scolded Gorachand at length:

পাঠ সাঠ গেল তোর অধমের হেন ।
কুবুদ্ধি হইয়া কেনে বুল অনুক্ষণ ॥ ৪৮৭ ॥

pāṭha sāṭha gela tora adhamera hena |
kubuddhi haiẏā kene bula anukṣaṇa || 487 ||

patha-satha gela tora — all your studies are ruined; adhamera hena — like a good-for-nothing's; kubuddhi haiya — being foolish; kene bula anukshana — why do you roam about all the time

487"All Your studies are ruined, as with some good-for-nothing!
Why, with Your foolish mind, do You roam about all the time?

ব্রাহ্মণকুমার হঞা নাহিক আচার ।
ইহার উচিত ফল দিতেছি তোমার ॥ ৪৮৮ ॥

brāhmaṇakumāra hañā nāhika ācāra |
ihāra ucita phala ditechi tomāra || 488 ||

brahmana-kumara hana — being a brahmana's son; nahika achara — there is no proper conduct; ihara uchita phala — the fitting fruit of this; ditechhi tomara — I am giving you

488You are a brahmana's son, yet You have no proper conduct —
I am giving You now the fruit You deserve."

ইহা বলি জগন্নাথ হাথে ছাট ধরি ।
তর্জন করিতে শচী তার হাথে ধরি ॥ ৪৮৯ ॥

ihā bali jagannātha hāthe chāṭa dhari |
tarjana karite śacī tāra hāthe dhari || 489 ||

iha bali — saying this; jagannatha hathe chhata dhari — Jagannatha, taking a switch in hand; tarjana karite — as he threatened; shachi tara hathe dhari — Shachi caught his hand

489Saying this, Jagannatha took a switch in his hand;
as he threatened, Shachi caught hold of his hand:

না মারিহ পুত্র মোর না খেলিবে আর ।
সর্বদা পড়িবে কাছে থাকিয়া তোমার ॥ ৪৯০ ॥

nā māriha putra mora nā khelibe āra |
sarbadā paṛibe kāche thākiẏā tomāra || 490 ||

na mariha putra mora — do not beat my son; na khelibe ara — He will not play any more; sarvada padibe — He will always study; kachhe thakiya tomara — staying near you

490"Do not beat my son! He will not play any more;
He will always study, sitting beside you."

বিশ্বম্ভর সান্ধাইলা জননীর কোলে ।
না খেলিব না খেলিব ধীরে ধীরে বোলে ॥ ৪৯১ ॥

biśbambhara sāndhāilā jananīra kole |
nā kheliba nā kheliba dhīre dhīre bole || 491 ||

vishvambhara sandhaila — Vishvambhara slipped into; jananira kole — His mother's lap; na kheliba na kheliba — "I won't play, I won't play"; dhire dhire bole — says very softly

491Vishvambhara hid in His mother's lap
and says very softly, "I won't play, I won't play."

জগন্নাথে পাছে করি পুত্র আগোরিয়া ।
না মারিহ পুত্র মোর মৈল ডরাইয়া ॥ ৪৯২ ॥

jagannāthe pāche kari putra āgoriẏā |
nā māriha putra mora maila ḍarāiẏā || 492 ||

jagannathe pachhe kari — pushing Jagannatha back; putra agoriya — shielding the son; na mariha putra mora — do not beat my son; maila daraiya — He is dying of fright

492Pushing Jagannatha back and shielding her son,
[Shachi says:] "Do not beat my son — He is dying of fright!"

ইহা বলি শচীদেবী পুত্র করি কোলে ।
বয়ান মুছিল অঙ্গ-বসন-অঞ্চলে ॥ ৪৯৩ ॥

ihā bali śacīdebī putra kari kole |
baẏāna muchila aṅga-basana-añcale || 493 ||

iha bali — saying this; shachidevi putra kari kole — Shachi-devi, taking her son on her lap; bayana muchhila — wiped His face; anga-vasana-anchale — with the end of her garment

493Saying this, Shachi-devi took her son on her lap
and wiped His face with the end of her sari.

না পড়ুক পুত্র মোর হউক মুরুখ ।
মুরুখ হইয়া শত বরিষ জীউক ॥ ৪৯৪ ॥

nā paṛuka putra mora hauka murukha |
murukha haiẏā śata bariṣa jīuka || 494 ||

na paduka putra mora — let my son not study; hauka murukha — let Him be a dunce; murukha haiya — being a dunce; shata barisha jiuka — may He live a hundred years

494"Let my son not study, let Him be a dunce —
as long as, a dunce, He lives a hundred years!"

শুনিঞা শচীর বাণী মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
কহিতে লাগিল কিছু সক্রোধ উত্তর ॥ ৪৯৫ ॥

śuniñā śacīra bāṇī miśra purandara |
kahite lāgila kichu sakrodha uttara || 495 ||

shuniya shachira vani — hearing Shachi's words; mishra purandara — Mishra Purandara; kahite lagila kichhu — began to speak; sakrodha uttara — an angry reply

495Hearing Shachi's words, Mishra Purandara
began to answer her in anger:

মুরুখ হইলে পুত্র জীবেক কেমনে ।
কেমনে ব্রাহ্মণ ইহায় কন্যা দিবে দানে ॥ ৪৯৬ ॥

murukha haile putra jībeka kemane |
kemane brāhmaṇa ihāẏa kanyā dibe dāne || 496 ||

murukha haile putra — if the son is a dunce; jiveka kemane — how will he live; kemane brahmana — how will a brahmana; ihaya kanya dibe dane — give him a daughter in marriage

496"If our son is a dunce, how will He make a living?
What brahmana will give Him a daughter in marriage?"

তবে জগন্নাথ দেখে পুত্রের বয়ান ।
পিতা-পানে চাহে পুত্র তরাস-নয়ান ॥ ৪৯৭ ॥

tabe jagannātha dekhe putrera baẏāna |
pitā-pāne cāhe putra tarāsa-naẏāna || 497 ||

tabe jagannatha dekhe — then Jagannatha sees; putrera bayana — his son's face; pita-pane chahe putra — the son looks at his father; tarasa-nayana — with frightened eyes

497Then Jagannatha looked at his son's face:
the son looks at his father with frightened eyes.

অন্তরে পোড়য়ে মিশ্র বাহিরে কঠিন ।
ফেলিল হাথের ছাট প্রেম-পরবীণ ॥ ৪৯৮ ॥

antare poṛaẏe miśra bāhire kaṭhina |
phelila hāthera chāṭa prema-parabīṇa || 498 ||

antare podaye mishra — Mishra burns within; bahire kathina — outwardly stern; phelila hathera chhata — threw away the switch from his hand; prema-paravina — overcome by love

498Mishra's heart burns, though outwardly he is stern —
and, overcome by love, he threw away the switch.

সজল নয়ানে পুত্র লঞা কৈল কোলে ।
পুত্রেরে বুঝায় মিশ্র সুমধুর বোলে ॥ ৪৯৯ ॥

sajala naẏāne putra lañā kaila kole |
putrere bujhāẏa miśra sumadhura bole || 499 ||

sajala nayane — with tearful eyes; putra lana kaila kole — took his son on his lap; putrere bujhaya mishra — Mishra persuades the son; sumadhura bole — with sweet words

499With tears in his eyes he took his son on his lap
and gently persuades Him with sweet words:

পড়িলে শুনিলে বাপা লোকে বোলে ভাল ।
আমি পাটধড়া দিব কদলক আর ॥ ৫০০ ॥

paṛile śunile bāpā loke bole bhāla |
āmi pāṭadhaṛā diba kadalaka āra || 500 ||

padile shunile — if one studies and listens; bapa — my boy; loke bole bhala — people speak well; ami patadhada diba — I will give a silk dhoti; kadalaka ara — and bananas

500"Of one who studies and listens to his lessons, my boy, people speak well;
and I will give You a silk dhoti and bananas."

এইমতে আনন্দে সানন্দে দিন গেলা ।
সন্ধ্যা সমাপিয়া মিশ্র শয়ন করিলা ॥ ৫০১ ॥

eimate ānande sānande dina gelā |
sandhyā samāpiẏā miśra śaẏana karilā || 501 ||

eimate — thus; anande sanande — in joy and gladness; dina gela — the day passed; sandhya samapiya — having finished the evening rites; mishra shayana karila — Mishra went to bed

501Thus in joy and gladness the day went by;
having finished his evening rites, Mishra went to bed.

নিদ্রাগত হৈল রাত্রি তৃতীয় প্রহর ।
স্বপন দেখিয়া মিশ্র হইলা ফাঁফর ॥ ৫০২ ॥

nidrāgata haila rātri tṛtīẏa prahara |
sbapana dekhiẏā miśra hailā phāṁphara || 502 ||

nidragata haila — fell asleep; ratri tritiya prahara — in the third watch of the night; svapana dekhiya — seeing a dream; mishra haila phanphara — Mishra became perturbed

502He fell asleep, and in the third watch of the night
Mishra had a dream and was thrown into turmoil.

রাত্রি সুপ্রভাতে উঠি ডাকিল সভারে ।
স্বপ্ন এক দেখিয়াছি কহি সভাকারে ॥ ৫০৩ ॥

rātri suprabhāte uṭhi ḍākila sabhāre |
sbapna eka dekhiẏāchi kahi sabhākāre || 503 ||

ratri suprabhate uthi — rising at daybreak; dakila sabhare — called everyone; svapna eka dekhiyachhi — I have seen a dream; kahi sabhakare — I tell everyone

503Rising at daybreak, he called everyone:
"I have seen a dream — I will tell you all.

দেখিল ত এক দ্বিজ পুরুষ বিশাল ।
দিনকর-কিরণ বরণ উজিয়ার ॥ ৫০৪ ॥

dekhila ta eka dbija puruṣa biśāla |
dinakara-kiraṇa baraṇa ujiẏāra || 504 ||

dekhila ta — I saw; eka dvija purusha vishala — a brahmana of majestic stature; dinakara-kirana barana — coloured like the sun's rays; ujiyara — radiant

504I saw a brahmana of majestic stature,
radiant like the rays of the sun.

রত্ন-অলঙ্কারে সে ভূষিত দিব্যদেহ ।
নিরখি না পারি ঝলমল করে গেহ ॥ ৫০৫ ॥

ratna-alaṅkāre se bhūṣita dibyadeha |
nirakhi nā pāri jhalamala kare geha || 505 ||

ratna-alankare — with jewelled ornaments; se bhushita divyadeha — his divine body adorned; nirakhi na pari — I cannot look; jhalamala kare geha — the house blazes

505His divine body was adorned with jewels;
I could not look at him — the whole house was ablaze.

বলিল আমারে মেঘগম্ভীর-বচনে ।
বিশ্বম্ভর নিজপুত্র করি মান কেনে ॥ ৫০৬ ॥

balila āmāre meghagambhīra-bacane |
biśbambhara nijaputra kari māna kene || 506 ||

balila amare — he said to me; meghagambhira-vachane — in a voice deep as thunder; vishvambhara nijaputra — Vishvambhara as your own son; kari mana kene — why do you regard

506In a voice deep as thunder he said to me:
'Why do you regard Vishvambhara as your son?

আমি দেব নারায়ণ ইহা নাহি জান ।
কেবল আপন সুত করি কেনে মান ॥ ৫০৭ ॥

āmi deba nārāẏaṇa ihā nāhi jāna |
kebala āpana suta kari kene māna || 507 ||

ami deva narayana — I am God, Narayana; iha nahi jana — this you do not know; kevala apana suta — merely as your son; kari kene mana — why do you regard

507I am God, Narayana — and you do not know it;
why do you regard [Me] merely as your son?8

পশু না জানয়ে স্পর্শমণির পরশ ।
পুত্রজ্ঞানে জান মোরে এ বড় সহজ ॥ ৫০৮ ॥

paśu nā jānaẏe sparśamaṇira paraśa |
putrajñāne jāna more e baṛa sahaja || 508 ||

pashu na janaye — a beast does not know; sparshamanira parasha — the touch of the philosopher's stone; putrajnane jana more — you know Me as your son; e bada sahaja — this is only natural

508A beast does not know the touch of the philosopher's stone;
you take Me for your son — but for you that is only natural.9

সর্বশাস্ত্র জানি আমি সর্বদেব-গুরু ।
আমা পড়াইবারে কেনে হাথে ছাট ধরু ॥ ৫০৯ ॥

sarbaśāstra jāni āmi sarbadeba-guru |
āmā paṛāibāre kene hāthe chāṭa dharu || 509 ||

sarvashastra jani ami — I know all the shastras; sarvadeva-guru — the Guru of all the gods; ama padaibare — to teach Me; kene hathe chhata dharu — why do you take a switch in hand

509I know all the shastras, I am the Guru of all the gods;
why then do you take a switch in hand to teach Me?'

এহেন স্বপন আজি দেখিয়াছি আমি ।
সেই অবধি মোর হিয়া করয়ে কি জানি ॥ ৫১০ ॥

ehena sbapana āji dekhiẏāchi āmi |
sei abadhi mora hiẏā karaẏe ki jāni || 510 ||

ehena svapana aji — such a dream today; dekhiyachhi ami — I have seen; sei avadhi — since then; mora hiya karaye ki jani — my heart does I know not what

510Such a dream I have seen today,
and ever since, I do not know what is happening in my heart."

শচী অতি হৃষ্টমন আর সর্বজন ।
সভে নিরখয়ে বিশ্বম্ভরের বদন ॥ ৫১১ ॥

śacī ati hṛṣṭamana āra sarbajana |
sabhe nirakhaẏe biśbambharera badana || 511 ||

shachi ati hrishtamana — Shachi was overjoyed; ara sarvajana — and all the people; sabhe nirakhaye — all gaze; vishvambharera vadana — at Vishvambhara's face

511Shachi was overjoyed, and so were all the people;
all gaze at Vishvambhara's face.

শচী-জগন্নাথ কোলে করে হিয়া ভরি ।
আমার তনয় বিশ্বম্ভর গৌরহরি ॥ ৫১২ ॥

śacī-jagannātha kole kare hiẏā bhari |
āmāra tanaẏa biśbambhara gaurahari || 512 ||

shachi-jagannatha kole kare — Shachi and Jagannatha embrace; hiya bhari — to their heart's content; amara tanaya — our son; vishvambhara gaurahari — Vishvambhara Gaurahari

512Shachi and Jagannatha embrace Him, pressing Him to their hearts:
"Our son is Vishvambhara Gaurahari!

অনন্ত মহিমা যার বেদে নাহি জানে ।
শিব-সনকাদি যারে নাহি পায় ধেয়ানে ॥ ৫১৩ ॥

ananta mahimā yāra bede nāhi jāne |
śiba-sanakādi yāre nāhi pāẏa dheẏāne || 513 ||

ananta mahima yara — whose boundless glory; vede nahi jane — the Vedas do not know; shiva-sanakadi — Shiva, Sanaka and the others; yare nahi paya dheyane — whom they do not attain in meditation

513He whose boundless glory the Vedas do not know,
whom Shiva, Sanaka and the others do not attain in meditation —

হেন মহা-মহত্ত্ব মহিমা জানে কেবা ।
মোর পুত্র হইয়া জনমে গৌর দেবা ॥ ৫১৪ ॥

hena mahā-mahattba mahimā jāne kebā |
mora putra haiẏā janame gaura debā || 514 ||

hena maha-mahattva — of such a Greatest One; mahima jane keba — who knows the greatness; mora putra haiya — becoming my son; janame gaura deva — Lord Gaura (Gaura-deva) is born

514who can know the greatness of this Greatest One?
Lord Gaura has been born as my son!"

বলিতে বলিতে স্নেহ বাৎসল্য হইল ।
ঐশ্বর্য যতেক ভাব সব দূরে গেল ॥ ৫১৫ ॥

balite balite sneha bātsalya haila |
aiśbarya yateka bhāba saba dūre gela || 515 ||

balite balite — even as they spoke; sneha vatsalya haila — tenderness, parental love arose; aishvarya yateka bhava — every feeling of majesty; saba dure gela — all went far away

515But even as they spoke, tender parental love (vatsalya) awoke in them,
and every feeling of His majesty withdrew.10

স্বপন শুনিয়া সর্বজনের উল্লাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৫১৬ ॥

sbapana śuniẏā sarbajanera ullāsa |
gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 516 ||

svapana shuniya — hearing of the dream; sarvajanera ullasa — all people rejoice; goraguna gaya sukhe — joyfully sings Gora's glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

516Hearing of the dream, all the people rejoice —
the glories of Gora are joyfully sung by this Lochana Dasa.

✦

Notes

  1. "Hate khadi", "chalk in the hand": the rite of beginning to learn letters (vidyarambha), when the child first traces letters with chalk.
  2. Here in the OCR of the summary the lines are overlaid by text from a neighbouring page (vv. 416–418), and part of the sentence is lost; in substance it concerns the games with the boys, the father's anger (vv. 473–500) and Jagannatha's dream (vv. 501–516).
  3. The name or word before "began His studies" is unreadable in the OCR.
  4. Vv. 459+1 – 459+3 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition does not have them. "Ka, kha, ga, gha" are the first letters of the Bengali alphabet; "with all their signs" is literally "all the phalas", the signs for conjunct consonants.
  5. Chudakarana is the samskara of the first cutting of the hair, leaving a lock (shikha) on the crown.
  6. V. 472+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition does not have it, but gives in a footnote, from one manuscript, a different signature: "Meditating on the lotus feet of Narahari, Lochana joyfully sings of Chaitanya."
  7. That is, announcing this game; the 1983 edition has "thus".
  8. In the dream the brahmana speaks in the person of the Lord Himself. In Murari (1.07.14–16) the brahmana speaks to Jagannatha about his son, and Mishra replies that even if his son is Narayana, it is a father's duty to correct Him.
  9. So A ("e bada sahaja"). The 1983 edition reads "e bada sahasa": "this is great audacity".
  10. Cf. the Bhagavata (10.8.43–45): Yashoda, having seen the universe in Krishna's mouth, is at once covered again by His yogamaya and sees in Him only her son. The parental love (vatsalya) of Shachi and Jagannatha does not admit the thought of the Lord's majesty, and He Himself by His own will hides it for the sake of their love.
